## What's new in Dropshake v1.2.6

- Added a menu bar option to enable or disable clearing shelf items when opening the shelf.
- Applied the reset setting consistently to shakes and the **Open Shelf** command, including ⌘E.

## Install

Download `Dropshake.dmg`, open it, drag Dropshake into Applications, then eject the Dropshake disk in Finder. Requires macOS 13 or later. The universal app supports both Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
